title: Introduction to Percentages
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through introduction to percentages.
definition: A percentage is a number expressed per hundred. The symbol % means divide by 100. Convert between fractions, decimals and percentages by expressing the same quantity in different notation.

formulas.description: Convert a fraction to a percentage.

exercises.question: Convert 20% to a fraction in lowest terms.
